crafts.name: Paper Lantern
instructions: Inflate a balloon to the desired size
Tear the paper into medium-sized pieces
Make a mixture using 1-2 spoons of glue and a cup of water. Add more glue if needed
Gently dip a piece of paper into the mixture, then paste it onto the balloon
Repeat until the entire surface of the balloon is covered, leaving a small area around the knot. Add 2-3 layers of paper, then leave it to dry
Carefully pop the balloon and remove it from the paper cover once dry
Gently paint the lantern with eyeshadow or colours
Place fake lights inside the lantern and display it wherever you like!
crafts.sustainability_note: Paper is reused and transformed into a lightweight and decorative lantern instead of being discarded.
environmental_benefits: Reuses sheets of paper and prevents environmental contamination

crafts.name: Homemade Paper
instructions: Tear the paper scraps into small pieces
Place them in a container, pour a cup of water over them, and leave overnight to soften
Blend the soaked paper to create paper pulp
Take a small amount of pulp, place it into a bucket of water, and mix
Shake the paper-making frame in the pulp water to collect the loose pulp
Gently empty the frame onto a surface in the sun and leave it to dry for 5-8 hours
Peel off your homemade paper from the surface and your paper is complete!
crafts.sustainability_note: Paper scraps are given a second life by being transformed into new sheets of paper.
environmental_benefits: Reuses large amounts of paper scraps

crafts.name: Paper Mache Clay
instructions: Add the paper shreds to a container
Fill the container with enough water to cover the paper
Mix and knead until the paper becomes a mash
Pour white glue into the paper mash
Alternate between adding more paper and glue while kneading until you reach a moldable mixture
You now have paper mache clay that can be used to create anything you want!
crafts.sustainability_note: Paper is upcycled into a creative and reusable material for making different crafts.
environmental_benefits: Creates a fun and creative activity

crafts.name: Wall Decor
instructions: Roll the paper into thin straws
Place the paper straws on the design outline
Hot glue the paper straws together to form the design
Paint and decorate the design
Stick it onto the wall and your decoration is complete!
crafts.sustainability_note: Newspaper is recycled into an easy DIY wall decoration instead of being thrown away.
environmental_benefits: Creates a DIY project that helps the environment

crafts.name: Hanging Wall Decor
instructions: Use paper to cut out desired shapes
Arrange the shapes into a line
Tape the pieces onto a string
Repeat for the desired number of garlands
Hang them up wherever you would like!
crafts.sustainability_note: Paper is reused to create a fun and eye-catching DIY decoration.
environmental_benefits: Creates a DIY project that benefits the environment
